wish: someone should make an app that makes family trees simple enough for anyone
spec:
Builds a family tree from names alone and draws it by generation, with partners side by side and lines to their children.
Type a name, tap whether they are a parent, partner or child of the selected person; tap anyone in the tree to select, rename or remove them. Remarriage and half-siblings are handled by choosing which partner a child belongs to.
Works offline and stays on this device; saves and reopens a JSON file and exports the tree as an SVG picture, but does not search records or sync anywhere.
notes: Saving and opening files uses local download and file picker only; no network.
